from fractions import Fraction as F

# Solve 4x+5 = A(x-1) + B(x+2) using x=1 and x=-2 (exact)
B = F(4*1+5, 1+2)        # x=1: 9 = 3B
A = F(4*(-2)+5, -2-1)    # x=-2: -3 = -3A
print("A =", A, "B =", B)

# Verify decomposition at many sample points (also exact identity: two linear polys
# agreeing at 2 points are identical, so this is a proof for degree<=1)
ok = True
for n in range(-50, 51):
    x = F(n, 3)
    if x in (F(-2), F(1)):
        continue
    lhs = (4*x+5) / (x*x + x - 2)
    rhs = A/(x+2) + B/(x-1)
    if lhs != rhs:
        ok = False
print("decomposition verified:", ok)

# Target expression: B/(x+1) - A/(x-2) vs closed form (2x-7)/((x+1)(x-2))
closed_ok = True
equals_2_points = []
for n in range(-50, 51):
    x = F(n, 3)
    if x in (F(-1), F(2)):
        continue
    val = B/(x+1) - A/(x-2)
    if val != (2*x-7)/((x+1)*(x-2)):
        closed_ok = False
    if val == 2:
        equals_2_points.append(x)
print("closed form (2x-7)/((x+1)(x-2)) verified on samples:", closed_ok)
print("points where expression == 2 (sampled):", equals_2_points)
